'''Karl Horn''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[October 2000 Virginia Beach tournament]] on 22 October 2000, according to Mark Balderston's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1390">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-26-va-beach-va-comic-alternativa-10-22-00d1390/ va-beach-va-comic-alternativa-10-22-00], DeckTech (Mark "Rogue Nine" Balderston, 26 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-26-va-beach-va-comic-alternativa-10-22-00d1390/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
